title: A survived-verdict finding, placed under archive/ at fixture-setup time
content: This finding (research-harness-template#566) deliberately carries verdict='survived' — an otherwise-clean verdict — but is copied under archive/ (not findings/) by the eval. It exists to prove EXCLUSION IS STRUCTURAL (by directory), not verdict-based: a finding with a perfectly good verdict must still be excluded from the survivor set purely because of where it lives on disk.
summary: Survived-verdict finding, archived — proves exclusion is structural (by directory), not by verdict.

verification.verdict_basis: Placeholder gate result for the eval — genuinely 'survived', but archived and must still be excluded.
